reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 455 for the 1820-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 455 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 whose length 455 meets the lower bound, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. Kneser K(16,4) hypothesis was consistent and only 1 code was tried. Versus baselines: CP-SAT alpha found 455 but did not prove it in 123 s; cpsat_cover and frac_cover (1800) failed; f2_minrank_sat reached only a lower 454. The kushagra_agent also proved 455 exactly, in 1.90 s, far faster than our 48.87 s wall time, of which 47.93 s was LLM time (compute only 0.94 s). Accuracy ties the best baseline; time is a clear loss. Nothing suspicious.
